email_draft.subject: Salt Lake's RFP-2026-014, scoped in time | Journify
email_draft.body:
Daniel, you liked a Journify post on March 20, four days before Salt Lake County posted RFP-2026-014 for Special Education Case Management and IEP Compliance Software.

At an estimated 5,740 IEPs, your case managers and related-service providers are carrying a compliance load that only compounds as timelines, prior written notices, and progress monitoring pile up across schools. Journify integrates with your IEP system of record so the whole team, teachers, therapists, paraprofessionals, works from one place, and teachers report saving more than four hours per day on documentation, which means your staff's time goes back to students. Proposals close May 30, and we can have a scoped response in front of your committee well before then.

Should I get on your calendar before the May 30 deadline for a focused 20-minute walk-through?
